</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row-full-width vc_clearfix"></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h2 style="text-align: center;">KITE SAFARI &#8211; A KITE HOLIDAY ON A KITING YACHT</h2>
<p style="text-align: center;">A Kite Safari is a week-long kitesurfing adventure on board our own yacht Heaven Liberty. Together with the Sick Dog Team and another 24 kiters, you will explore the best islands and lagoons that the Red Sea has to offer, using our boat as a moving hotel, where you can sleep, eat, chill, party, and enjoy the beauty of the Egyptian climate and wind.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>It&#8217;s an intensive kitesurfing week. </strong></p>
<p style="text-align: center;">We will kite from morning until evening, with a lunch break, in shallow waters and with steady winds.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>It&#8217;s a lot of kitesurfing &amp; kitesurfing progression is guaranteed &#8211; Kitesurfing lessons are included in the cost of the cruise.</strong></p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p></p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_inner vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h2 style="text-align: center;">KITE SAFARI BOATS</h2>
<p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.sickdogsurf.com/our-boats/">Our boats</a> are conveniently docked in the beautiful Hurghada Marina, and range from a 6 guests sail boat to a massive 26 guests boat.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Typically, the interior of the boat is on point, with air conditioning, a spacious lounge with a plasma TV/DVD set, and a modern sound system extending along the decks. A restaurant serves 3 tasty meals a day, prepared fresh by our chef. A bar and solarium are available to enjoy the sunset and have a drink after a long kitesurfing day.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Our boats are specifically designed for watersport activities and sea safaris, with an excellent compromise between the speed needed to cruise the sea and the stability required for our passengers. Two zodiacs are also present to help kitesurfers access the pristine lagoons and small islands of the Red Sea, and of course for rescuing kiters in need.</p>

		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h2 style="text-align: center;">WHERE TO ARRIVE</h2>
<p style="text-align: center;">The airport of arrival is Hurghada (HRG), Egypt. All you have to do is arrive at the airport &#8211; we will arrange your transfer to the boat and take care of everything from there.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h2 style="text-align: center;">HOW A KITE SAFARI WORKS</h2>
<p style="text-align: center;">We will meet onboard on Saturday, with the yacht opening its doors at midday, and we will spend the first night docked in the Marina. We depart in the early morning of Sunday (so you can arrive on board even Saturday night late, if needed), and during breakfast we will cruise to our first kite spot of the trip. Depending on wind conditions, we will choose the best islands and lagoons to kite daily. After the first kitesurfing morning, we will have a tasty lunch and then some extra hours kitesurfing in the afternoon. All decks of the boat are available at all times, if you prefer to stay in and chill a little. After the afternoon kitesurfing, we will have dinner, relax, have fun and sleep.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Almost every day we will move to a different location, including one downwind trip.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">If you don&#8217;t know how to kitesurf, you can learn during the kite safari with one of our qualified instructors. Lessons are included in the price of the cruise, which is why our kite safari is an intensive kite experience where progression is guaranteed. There are also extra activities available, stand up paddling, snorkeling and wakeboarding.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">We’ll be back to the marina on Friday afternoon after one week, we will have a final night on the boat, with an opportunity to explore the town of Hurghada, and leave the boat on Saturday.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div data-vc-full-width="true" data-vc-full-width-temp="true" data-vc-full-width-init="false" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center wpb_content_element">
		
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">
			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper  "><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="900" height="789" src="https://sickdogsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/kitesafarimapSD.jpg" class="vc_single_image-img attachment-large" alt="kite safari map" title="" srcset="https://sickdogsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/kitesafarimapSD.jpg 900w, https://sickdogsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/kitesafarimapSD-300x263.jpg 300w, https://sickdogsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/kitesafarimapSD-768x673.jpg 768w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 900px) 100vw, 900px" /></div>
		</figure>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row-full-width vc_clearfix"></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<div class="page" title="Page 2">
<div class="layoutArea">
<div class="column">
<h2 style="text-align: center;">KITESURFING CRUISE DAY BY DAY</h2>
<p><strong>ARRIVAL AT HURGHADA AIRPORT, EGYPT, SATURDAY – DAY 0</strong></p>
<p>After being welcomed at Hurghada airport you will be transferred to the Boat moored just 15 minutes away at one of Hurghada&#8217;s Marinas.<br />
We will have dinner on the boat, maybe grab a drink  if you are not too tired, and then get a good night sleep.  You will spend the first night on the boat, so that you are ready to depart on Sunday early morning.</p>
<p>In the event of an early arrival on Friday, you can ride with our team at some of the local spots and stay overnight in a hotel (on request).</p>
<p><strong>SUNDAY – DAY 1</strong></p>
<p>We depart to the north of the Red Sea for six days of cruising. After a 30-minute trip, we reach our first spot, <strong>Abu Mungar</strong>, for a warm-up session – a strip of sand perfect for setting up the kites, where you can kite on both sides. We will spend all day here and sleep here as well.</p>
<p><strong>DAY 2</strong></p>
<p data-start="4271" data-end="4609">In the early morning, we move to one of the best kitesurfing spots in the Red Sea, <strong>Tawila Island</strong>. A huge lagoon with crystal-clear, shallow water. Here our kitesurfing adventure really begins. Tawila is a secluded beach with a great atmosphere, far away from crowded coasts and cities.</p>
<p data-start="4611" data-end="4966">After a full day of kiting, a well-deserved drink on the main deck, and after the sunset, our crew might teach you how to catch calamari!</p>
<p data-start="4611" data-end="4966">As we wait for our meal to be cooked, you can check out the videos and pictures from the day’s session on our screens. We will be sleeping at Tawila, ready for an early morning session.</p>
<p><strong>DAY 3</strong></p>
<p>If you are up to it, we will wake up at <strong data-start="1790" data-end="1810">6 in the morning</strong> for a session before breakfast! We will spend the full day <strong data-start="1870" data-end="1883">in Tawila</strong>, and move in the afternoon to the third spot, <strong data-start="1930" data-end="1947">Geisum Island</strong>. We will be sleeping <strong data-start="1969" data-end="1982">in Geisum</strong>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="page" title="Page 3">
<div class="layoutArea">
<div class="column">
<p><strong>DAY 4</strong></p>
<p data-start="2009" data-end="2381">We will spend the full day in Geisum (again, we can kite from early morning), and move in the late afternoon to <strong data-start="2125" data-end="2172">Ashrafi Islands.</strong> During <strong data-start="2180" data-end="2200">the northernmost</strong> part of our safari, we’ll travel between the islands to a great lagoon, with perfect <strong data-start="2286" data-end="2300">side-shore</strong> wind and <strong data-start="2310" data-end="2378">deep waters for advanced riders and a shallow area for beginners</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="2383" data-end="2749">Why not take a look under your board? The water here is so clear that you’ll easily see dolphins as they glide through the water. A truly unspoiled area and a great place to take advantage of our stand up paddles and snorkeling equipment to explore the colorful coral below the surface. It’s also a great place for wakeboarding, as it is very quiet and flat!</p>
<p data-start="2751" data-end="2877">With no man-made light pollution, the stars here are bright and plentiful. Enjoy this spectacle with drinks on the deck.</p>
<p><strong>DAY 5</strong></p>
<p data-start="2901" data-end="3177">Before breakfast, we will start a <strong>10-km downwind ride</strong> to our next spot! The boat and our rescue team will follow us to <strong data-start="3024" data-end="3047">ensure extra safety</strong>. Starting with flat water, we’ll head outside to catch some serious swell. <strong data-start="3123" data-end="3175">It’s time to try some big carves and high jumps.</strong></p>
<p data-start="3179" data-end="3374">We’ll finish the day’s session back on<strong data-start="3215" data-end="3228"> Geisum</strong>. This is a great chance to explore the lagoons you may have missed last time, as the area is very large. We will be sleeping in Geisum.</p>
<p><strong>FRIDAY DAY 6</strong></p>
<p><strong>Early morning ride</strong> on the island lagoon. A great opportunity for a final picture session. We finish kiting around midday and enjoy a hearty lunch before heading back to Hurghada.<br />
Gear will be cleaned and packed at the marina. Still have energy for more fun? We’ll head out for a night in one of the area’s most popular beach nightclubs. We spend one last night on the boat in the marina.</p>
<p><strong>SATURDAY DAY 7</strong></p>
<p data-start="3845" data-end="4065">It’s time for goodbye! After breakfast, we will leave the boat. If you have a later flight, we can go kiting in some spots in Hurghada or El Gouna, or just chill at a nearby beach until it&#8217;s time to go.</p>
<p><strong>IMPORTANT: </strong>Our weekly route above may change due to wind conditions – we will do our best to visit as many kite spots as possible and stick to the classic safari route, but we cannot guarantee it.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div data-vc-full-width="true" data-vc-full-width-temp="true" data-vc-full-width-init="false" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid whitetext vc_custom_1759247433812 vc_row-has-fill"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_icon_element vc_icon_element-outer vc_custom_1736421388883 vc_do_icon vc_icon_element-align-center"><div class="vc_icon_element-inner  vc_icon_element-size-lg vc_icon_element-style-" ><span class="vc_icon_element-icon far fa-check-circle" style="color:#FFFFFF !important"></span></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element vc_custom_1766004105137 whitetext" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h5 style="text-align: center;"><strong>INCLUDED</strong></h5>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Transfers from the airport to boat and back</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Accommodation in a double room with A/C, private toilet and shower</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">3 Meals per day &#8211; breakfast, lunch and dinner.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Beach Assistance and Rescue</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Soft drinks, juices, tea and coffee</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">No-wind activities &#8211; Snorkeling Gear, Stand Up Paddle Boards, Wakeboarding</p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_icon_element vc_icon_element-outer vc_custom_1736421401843 vc_do_icon vc_icon_element-align-center"><div class="vc_icon_element-inner  vc_icon_element-size-lg vc_icon_element-style-" ><span class="vc_icon_element-icon far fa-times-circle" style="color:#FFFFFF !important"></span></div></div>

<p style="text-align: center;">Tips for the crew &#8211; 70€ (Heaven Liberty Yacht) &#8211; 80€ (New Regency Yacht)</p>
